body: New annotation system for subjects that collide with third-party IP (e.g. Paimon/Genshin) -- disambiguating context appended to the real generation prompt only, never the EZ prompt/subject/taxonomy. Supports multiple aliases per subject (tyler-lore vs genshin-impact for Paimon), auto-derivation from TYLER's hero compendium + Goetia frequency table, and backfilling already-published nodes. Commit emily.cli fdf1e39.
title: Subject-level prompt annotations for Prompt-o-verse
